blocks.text: Sab se aam biological hazards yeh hain: allergens (allergy paida karne wali cheezen), janwaron se insanon mein aane wali infectious (ek se doosre ko lagne wali) bimariyan, aur viral bimariyan.

blocks.alt: Laal panel jis par 'Biological Hazards' likha hai, beech mein ek rod jaisa microbe (jaraseem) aur chaar circles mein labels: Microbes, Animals, Plants, Genetically modified agents.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.3: Kuch biological hazards (kitab ki Figure 16.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

janwaron se insanon ko lagne wali infectious bimariyan

blocks.prompt: Janwaron se insanon ko lagne wali bimariyan lab ka khatra kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Lab mein istemal hone wala biological material aur janwar aise jaraseem (germs) rakh sakte hain jo insanon ko lag jayein; is liye yeh allergens aur viral bimariyon ke saath biological hazard hain.

items: Biological hazards: allergens, janwaron se insanon ko lagne wali infectious bimariyan, viral bimariyan.
